use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[test]
fn logical_scalar_truth_table() {
    let actual = evaluate(&BTreeMap::new()).unwrap();
    let mut index = 0;
    for op in 0..2 {
        for left in 0..5 {
            for right in 0..5 {
                let expected = if op == 0 {
                    if left == 0 || right == 0 { Value::Boolean(false) }
                    else if left == 1 && right == 1 { Value::Boolean(true) }
                    else { Value::Null }
                } else {
                    if left == 1 || right == 1 { Value::Boolean(true) }
                    else if left == 0 && right == 0 { Value::Boolean(false) }
                    else { Value::Null }
                };
                let id = format!("c{index}");
                assert_eq!(actual.get(&("urn:rust-proof:logical-scalars", id.as_str())), Some(&expected), "{op}/{left}/{right}");
                index += 1;
            }
        }
    }
}
